steps.instruction: Cut 2 eggplants in half lengthwise, leaving a 1/4 inch rind.
Scoop out the eggplant flesh with a curved serrated grapefruit knife.
Place the chopped eggplant in a large, deep skillet or flat-bottomed wok.
Rub the inside of the eggplant shells with olive oil.
Set the shells aside on a baking sheet.
Add 1/4 pound of sliced mushrooms and 1/2 pound of chopped tomatoes to the skillet.
Add 1 cup of chopped onions and 4 large cloves of minced garlic.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, pepper and the rest of the oil.
Sauté for 5 minutes or more, until soft but still chunky.
steps.spoken: Sauté for 5 to 10 minutes, until the vegetables are soft but still chunky.

steps.instruction: Broil the shells 3 inches from the heat for 8 minutes or more.
steps.spoken: Broil the shells 3 inches from the heat for 8 to 12 minutes, until they are tender when poked with a fork. Be careful not to burn them.

steps.instruction: Take the shells out from under the broiler and set them aside.
Add the walnuts, 3 heaping tablespoons of capers and the tomato paste to the skillet.
Fill the eggplant shells with the cooked mixture.
Top with the sliced tomatoes, then sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes or more.
